categories.obsolete_historical_assertion: A superseded release identity, version, cache marker, schema snapshot or historical packaging assertion. Repair the test only; production must not be changed to satisfy it.
categories.environment_dependent: A browser, PHP/process, filesystem, timing, network, host-capacity or local-service assertion whose result depends on the execution environment.
categories.potential_real_defect: A behavioral assertion not proven obsolete or environmental. Document and defer investigation; do not silently change v2.11.1 production behavior.
